{{Quote|But the evidence is considerably more clear that the Rakata waged devastating war against the Kwa and the Gree. And the Killiks simply vanished. All three, we believe, were key client species of the Celestials. It looks as if the Rakata were determined to exterminate or drive out their rivals among the Celestial slave species.|Dr. Insmot Bowen discusses the war with Bevel Lemelisk and Conan Antonio Motti|<ref name="The Celestials" />}}
Following the [[Rakatan revolt]] against the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] waged<ref name="EGtW" /> devastating<ref name="The Celestials" /> '''war''' against their rivals among the Celestial client species, namely the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]],<ref name="EGtW" /> the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Empire]] and the [[Kwa holdings]]. At some point, they had driven back the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] to their home cluster and all but exterminated the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on the corresponding data for [[Oaka Prime system/Legends|Oaka Prime system]].</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oaka Prime]] was designated as a wildlife preserve to serve as a refuge away from the war.<ref name="SW20">[[Star Wars (2013) 20|''Star Wars'' (2013) 20]]</ref>
